english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for describing someone as kind-hearted and willing to help others.

english.meaning: having a specified kind of heart
english.note: Use this for being kind-hearted or well-meaning; it is the everyday positive description.
This is the all-purpose casual choice for someone kindly disposed or acting for others' good.
Use this for a casual description of someone who means well and is willing to help.

examples.english: They are really kind and always help people.
examples.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sam1 seng4 jat6 bong1 jan4

examples.english: They are kind-hearted and offered to watch my luggage.
examples.traditional: 佢好心幫我睇住啲行李。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 sam1 bong1 ngo5 tai2 zyu6 di1 haang4 lei5

examples.english: They are really benevolent; whenever they see elderly people, they help out.
examples.traditional: 佢真係好心，見到老人家就幫手。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sam1 gin3 dou3 lou5 jan4 gaa1 zau6 bong1 sau2

examples.english: It was kindly of you to watch my bag for me, thanks so much.
examples.traditional: 你咁好心幫我睇住個袋，唔該晒。
examples.jyutping: nei5 gam3 hou2 sam1 bong1 ngo5 tai2 zyu6 go3 doi6 m4 goi1 saai3
